engine_rule: Zend/zend_vm_def.h ZEND_INIT_DYNAMIC_CALL selects the array callback before ZEND_SEND_UNPACK; object selection retains its receiver, class-string selection retains called scope, and the by-reference Traversable warning uses EX(call)->func->common.scope (the declaring class).
